q: The first and foremost document in the Order of Precedence of Documents as Per 1.01 of GCC for Works, 2020 July is _____

options.A: IR Standard GCC updated with correction slips issued up to the date of inviting Tender

e: Letter of Award — that is the right answer. . Under para 1.01 of the IR Standard General Conditions of Contract for Works (July 2020), the order of precedence of documents begins with the Letter of Acceptance (Letter of Award) as the first and foremost document, followed by the Special Conditions of Contract, the IR Standard GCC updated with correction slips up to the date of inviting the tender, and so on through 11 documents in all. In any conflict between contract documents, the Letter of Acceptance prevails. Notice how precisely the correct option is worded.
